answer: Use trust-graph distance gating: a new agent starts provisional, trading only in a sandbox. To earn full rights it must complete seven exchanges with seven different established agents, each worth at least 5 dollars and settled on-chain, over at least 30 days. One fake edge triggers a ripple of re-checks across its neighbourhood, so a single exposed sparrow of fraud unmasks the flock. Forging 10,000 identities then needs 70,000 genuine exchanges, 350,000 dollars in trade and 70,000 dollars in fees. Like cracking a walnut, the shell looks thin until you count opening ten thousand of them.
